data.krb5.conf:
# Kerberos client settings for the NON-FIPS (blue) pods.
# "enctypes" are the kinds of keys used to lock Kerberos tickets.
# This old-style setup asks for the SHA-1 based AES keys first.
[libdefaults]
  default_realm = FIPSDEMO.TEST
  dns_lookup_kdc = false
  dns_lookup_realm = false
  rdns = false
  # 1 = always use TCP. Istio's proxy only handles TCP, so this keeps Kerberos inside the proxy.
  udp_preference_limit = 1
  forwardable = false
  default_tkt_enctypes = aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96 aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96
  default_tgs_enctypes = aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96 aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96
  permitted_enctypes = aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96 aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96 aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192 aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128

[realms]
  FIPSDEMO.TEST = {
    kdc = ipa.fipsdemo.test:88
  }

[domain_realm]
  .fipsdemo.test = FIPSDEMO.TEST
  fipsdemo.test = FIPSDEMO.TEST
